nodes.description: Private owner address; central access-control principal for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances read/written by approve and transferFrom.
Whitelist mapping canSale that bypasses the sale-condition gate in ensure.
tradeAddress whitelisted sender set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
_saleNum maximum number of allowed sales per address, set by init and read by condition.
_minSale minimum transfer value gate configured by init.
_maxSale maximum transfer value gate configured by init.
_onSaleNum per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Internal view gate that grants sale permission to owner, UNI, tradeAddress or whitelisted addresses, otherwise calls condition.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum after calling ensure.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-condition checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Privileged mint that sets balanceOf[spender] = addedValue * 10**decimals and whitelists the spender.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow guards.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure function deriving a Uniswap pair address from factory and token ordering.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, totalSupply, owner and the initial balance/allowance.
msg.sender is attacker-controllable and drives every access-control check in the contract.
Raw delegatecall in delegate(a,b) executes arbitrary code in the storage context of this contract.
Parameter _from of transferFrom and ensure.
Parameter _to of transfer and transferFrom.
Parameter _value used for amount arithmetic in transfer/transferFrom/ensure/condition.
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter a, target address of the delegatecall in delegate.
Parameter b, calldata passed to the delegatecall in delegate.
Parameter spender of _mints, receives minted balances.
Parameter addedValue of _mints, multiplied by 10**decimals.
Parameter saleNum of init, stored into _saleNum.
Parameter token of init, scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init, scaled into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos address array of batchSend.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress stored into tradeAddress.
Loop index i in batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, subject to overflow.
Local _UNI pair address computed in ensure via pairFor.
Local pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: transfer forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as _from.
msg.sender is passed as the source of the transfer.
transferFrom calls ensure to gate the transfer.
ensure falls back to condition when no whitelist entry matches.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall after the owner check.
The delegatecall transfers execution control into an attacker-supplied address.
msg.sender must equal owner before the delegatecall is executed.
delegate reads owner for authorization.
msg.sender is used as the allowance spender in transferFrom.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or the hardcoded address.
_mints reads owner for its authorization check.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
init reads owner for its authorization check.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist.
_mints computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) and assigns balanceOf[spender].
_mints marks the spender as canSale.
transferFrom subtracts from and adds to balanceOf unsafely.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
ensure reads canSale to bypass the sale condition.
ensure reads tradeAddress for whitelist bypass.
ensure treats owner as a permanently whitelisted sender.
condition reads _saleNum.
condition reads _minSale.
condition reads _maxSale.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from].
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
constructor assigns owner.
constructor derives owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] in a loop.
pairFor computes and returns the pair address.
constructor sets totalSupply.
constructor mints the initial supply to msg.sender.
_from parameter flows into balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
_from parameter is compared against whitelists in ensure.
_to parameter flows into transfer/transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into transfer and value checks.
_spender parameter flows into the allowance write.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
spender parameter indexes balanceOf and canSale.
addedValue parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale.
_tos parameter drives the batchSend loop recipients.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
Loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
total local feeds the balance check and subtraction in batchSend.
_UNI local holds the pairFor result used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
pair local is the value returned by pairFor.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is an input parameter whose value is fully consumed by transferFrom/ensure logic.
_to is an input parameter only meaningful inside transfer's delegation to transferFrom.
_value is an input parameter consumed by the allowance, balance and sale-condition arithmetic.
_spender is an input parameter only used to index the allowance mapping in approve.
a is the delegatecall target parameter of delegate.
b is the delegatecall calldata parameter of delegate.
spender is the mint recipient parameter of _mints.
addedValue is the mint amount parameter of _mints.
saleNum is a configuration parameter of init stored into _saleNum.
token is a configuration parameter of init stored into _minSale.
maxToken is a configuration parameter of init stored into _maxSale.
_tos is the recipient array parameter driving the batchSend loop.
addr is the only parameter of setTradeAddress and is written to tradeAddress.
i is the loop counter local of batchSend.
total is the multiplication result local that gates and debits the sender balance.
_UNI is a local pair address computed inside ensure.
pair is the return local computed by pairFor.
